root.title: payload body
root.description: Exports the specified document block as HTML

pdf.description: Whether the export format is PDF

savePath.description: Export directory, exported to a temporary directory under `temp/export/` when empty (see `folder` in the response)

keepFold.description: Whether to keep the folding state

merge.description: Whether to merge the content of the sub-document

addTitle.description: Whether to add the document title at the beginning, the export setting is used by default

customTitle.description: Custom title, only used when `addTitle` is `true`, the document title is used when empty

mergeContentHeadingMode.title: TMergeContentHeadingMode
mergeContentHeadingMode.description:
How headings in the content are handled when merging sub-documents, only used when `merge` is `true`
- `preserve`: Keep the heading levels
- `demote`: Demote the headings to levels below the title of their document

mergeDocHeadingMode.title: TMergeDocHeadingMode
mergeDocHeadingMode.description:
Levels of the sub-document titles when merging sub-documents, only used when `merge` is `true`
- Empty string: Level by document depth
- `flat`: All level 1
- `tree`: Level by document depth, one level lower when the root title is added
